payload.artist_html: From a drawing by Charles R. Knight made under the direction of Professor Osborn.
payload.credit_html: “Palaeontology,” Encyclopædia Britannica (11th ed.), v. 20, 1911, Plate I, fig. 2. pages 580-581
payload.description_html:
A hypothetical pictorial restoration of the mother ichthyosaur accompanied by five of its newly born young, from the information furnished by actual fossils.
Note: This image as originally uploaded, here, is the correct orientation as published in the book.
